notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Give the rep a useful next move, then measure whether it helps.
intro: A proposed presales workbench for Zip: connect a procurement change signal to a grounded account brief, an existing owner and a measurable rep pilot.
queueIntro: A public change in the business can suggest a procurement question. It does not prove which purchasing process, supplier workflow or internal approval is broken.
workbenchIntro: Review the evidence, buyer coverage and rep ownership. A workflow should earn adoption through useful output, not merely generate more activity.
firstBuild: A procurement discovery brief reps can correct
firstBody: Connect a researched business change with finance, procurement and IT stakeholders. Preserve existing opportunities and collect rep corrections before broad rollout.

fields.label: Finance, procurement and IT coverage mapped
Existing opportunity or account owner checked
Pilot success metric and feedback loop agreed

rules.title: Refresh the business trigger
rules.next: Find a dated business change instead of assuming a company needs new procurement software.

rules.title: Write a procurement discovery question
rules.next: Connect the signal to a specific intake, approval or supplier process and keep the need unconfirmed.

rules.title: Map the buying group
rules.next: Identify known roles and gaps across procurement, finance and IT without inventing contacts.

rules.title: Check the current relationship
rules.next: Preserve an existing opportunity or owner before creating another prospecting motion.

rules.title: Assign the receiving rep
rules.next: The brief needs someone who can accept it, correct it and act on the next question.

rules.title: Define the rep pilot
rules.next: Agree on eligible users, useful-output acceptance, repeat use and a baseline before claiming time savings.

ready.title: Ready for a rep pilot review
ready.next: The rep can review the account context and next question. Capture corrections and adoption before increasing automation.

experiments.name: Procurement-specific call preparation
experiments.hypothesis: A sourced business change improves the first procurement discussion.
experiments.treatment: Business change, buying-group gaps and next question
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Rep feedback before rollout
experiments.hypothesis: A correction loop makes the workflow useful enough for repeat use.
experiments.treatment: Small pilot with accepted and returned briefs
experiments.primary: Repeat weekly use among eligible reps
experiments.guardrail: Review burden and unsupported time-saving claims
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Start with the rep’s actual task
roadmap.body: Observe BDR and AE research. Choose one procurement segment and define a useful brief with sales.
roadmap.measure: Accepted briefs and baseline preparation effort

roadmap.title: Pilot and earn adoption
roadmap.body: Build the research and ownership checks, collect corrections and instrument repeat use.
roadmap.measure: Eligible, active and repeat users; return reasons

roadmap.title: Scale what helps pipeline
roadmap.body: Connect accepted briefs to held discovery and qualified pipeline using a fixed cohort. Document failures and maintenance.
roadmap.measure: Qualified outcomes, adoption and measured effort

metricsTitle: Measure the workflow people return to.
metricsIntro: A synthetic two-week rep pilot. Accepted output, repeat use and qualified outcomes have different denominators.
metricsNotes: These numbers are invented examples, not Zip results or CJ’s prior outcomes.
Measure preparation effort before and after a pilot with comparable tasks; do not equate generated briefs with hours saved.
Pipeline influenced must remain separate from pipeline sourced and closed revenue.
aiApplication: At Zip, I would coordinate research across procurement, finance and IT context, attach public evidence and preserve existing opportunities. Rep corrections would become evaluation cases in a bounded loop before account-brief automation is scaled.
